taxonomic_note: Accepted species; FNA recognizes varieties, including var. gracillima. Source pool variety is represented within this species concept; do not duplicate.
look_here_first: Start at a mature head and fruit: pappus bristles are plumose to subplumose, with gland-dotted phyllaries. Inspect woody perennial base and leaf nodes, but remember some varieties have alternate rather than opposite leaves. Do not assign a variety from a species-level source row.

project_inclusion.learner_admission_basis: Approved Master Plant Pool row 159; taxonomy and diagnostics reviewed 2026-10-09
project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas-native at state scale in POWO; no completed BONAP/NAPA-first three-target-county certification for this batch. Native-only metrics excluded.

morphology_keys.habit: Perennial herb to subshrub with woody perennial base; habit varies across recognized varieties.
morphology_keys.leaves: Leaves usually opposite, but alternate in some varieties including gracillima and texana; phyllotaxy alone cannot reject the species.
morphology_keys.flowers: Heads discoid; phyllaries gland-dotted, often 22–26 across the complex; involucres roughly 7–15 mm, with about 6–35 florets.
morphology_keys.fruits: Mature cypsela pappus bristles plumose to subplumose; photograph with macro to distinguish from related brickellbushes.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Brickellia cylindracea (tomentose leaf undersides and strongly unequal outer phyllaries); Brickellia dentata (often alternate coarsely toothed leaves and usually glabrous mature cypselae). The source-pool B. eupatorioides var. gracillima is a nested infraspecific concept, not a second species card.
